newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy earmarks $60 million for Vietnam development.
newsitem.headline: Italy earmarks $60 million for Vietnam development.

text.p: Italy will make 100 billion lire ($60 million) available in aid credits to Vietnam for development projects in the southeast Asian state, the Italian Foreign Ministry said on Tuesday.
The ministry said a memorandum of understanding on the aid had been signed on Monday by foreign ministry undersecretary Patrizia Toia and Vietnamese deputy foreign minister Nguyen Van Nganh.
An agreement to enhance cultural links was also signed by Toia and Vietnamese deputy culture and information minister Nguyen Trung Kien, a ministry statement said.
The agreements were signed during a visit to Italy by Vietnam's Prime Minister Vo Van Kiet.
